evals.prompt: detached worktree에서 끝낸 검색 기능을 PR로 올려줘. 변경은 아직 커밋하지 않았어.
evals.expected_output: The response creates a named branch, commits the in-scope change, rebases, publishes, and opens a ready PR.
expectations: It preserves the detached work by creating a suitable branch.
It commits only the search feature as logical Conventional Commits.
It bases the branch on the fetched advertised remote default without losing the change.
It creates a ready-for-review PR and reports its URL.

evals.prompt: 현재 브랜치 PR 올려줘. 이 head branch로 이미 OPEN 상태의 PR이 하나 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response updates and reuses the existing PR rather than creating a duplicate.
expectations: It discovers the existing PR for the head branch.
It reuses that PR.
It reports the existing URL and current outstanding checks.

evals.prompt: PR 만들어줘. 확인해보니 이 브랜치의 변경은 어제 PR #42로 이미 main에 머지됐어.
evals.expected_output: The response reports the already completed remote outcome without opening another PR.
expectations: It checks remote main and existing PR state.
It does not create a duplicate branch or PR.
It reports PR #42 and the merged state.

evals.prompt: checkout 변경으로 PR 올려줘. worktree에는 다른 agent의 admin.ts와 내 .env도 같이 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response publishes only the checkout change while preserving unrelated and sensitive files.
expectations: It leaves admin.ts out because its ownership is outside the request.
It keeps .env out of history.
It creates a PR whose commits and summary cover only checkout.

evals.prompt: PR 올려줘. origin/main rebase 중 가격 계산 정책 충돌이 생겼고 어느 쪽이 맞는지 문서에도 없어.
evals.expected_output: The response preserves the work and requests the missing policy decision instead of publishing a guessed resolution.
expectations: It identifies the unresolved product-policy conflict.
It does not invent a price rule or bypass the conflict.
It leaves the work recoverable and asks for only the required intent.

evals.prompt: 리뷰 받을 PR을 만들어줘. draft로 만들거나 merge까지 하지는 마.
evals.expected_output: The response creates a ready-for-review PR and stops before merge.
expectations: It creates the PR in ready-for-review state.
Its title and body describe the actual outcome and validation.
It does not merge the PR.

evals.prompt: 기본 브랜치가 master인 저장소야. base를 따로 말하지 않았으니 현재 변경을 리뷰 가능한 PR로 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: The response resolves master as the remote default and opens the pull request against it.
expectations: It resolves the advertised remote default instead of assuming main.
It bases the change and pull request on master.
It reports master as the pull request base.
